title: Rams put Davante Adams, Poona Ford on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams put Davante Adams, Poona Ford on IR
sources.description: Wide receiver Davante Adams is expected to miss the next 6-10 weeks after rupturing his hamstring in last Sunday's loss to the Cardinals and the Rams moved him off of the active roster on Tuesday.
